concept.title: Working with Save Maps
concept.shortdesc: How many Save Maps you use is dependent on app design and how many save

conbody.p: How many Save Maps you use is dependent on app design and how many save options you have for the user at runtime. Remember the following when working with Save Maps:

ul.li: There is no limit to the number of Save Maps you can have in an app. Multiple Save Maps allows you to control which fields are updated when the user clicks a menu button associated with a specific save process.
A Save Map can include fields from any number of objects.
A Save Map can be used across multiple worksheets (not workbooks).
